synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: The only Richmond VIC record that describes an actual door specifies mid-century walk-up apartment stock rather than a house — the Airtasker Richmond VIC locksmith listing asks a quoter to cover "Removing old lock and installing the new smart lock" plus "Adjusting holes if needed (door is from a 1960s apartment block)" — so the governing constraint for smart lock installation here is retrofit fit against a 1960s apartment entry door whose existing lock cut-out is not expected to line up with modern smart lock hardware, and the second Richmond VIC listing likewise concerns a front-door retrofit of an Aqara Smart Lock A100.
synthesis.demographic_skew: Both Richmond VIC listings are occupants who have already bought the smart lock themselves and are shopping only for install labour on a gig marketplace rather than a supply-and-fit locksmith — one states "Locksmith or professional needed to install Aqara Smart lock A100 in front door Have unit already, you'll just need to bring tools, etc." and the other asks for a quote to fit "the new smart lock" they already have.
common_concerns: Whether the new smart lock will physically fit an older apartment door without a visibly re-worked cut-out — the Airtasker Richmond VIC locksmith listing itemises "Adjusting holes if needed (door is from a 1960s apartment block)" as part of the job being quoted.

Whether the installer will fit a lock the customer supplied and turn up with tools only — the Airtasker Richmond VIC lock installation listing reads "Locksmith or professional needed to install Aqara Smart lock A100 in front door Have unit already, you'll just need to bring tools, etc."

Cosmetic quality on an existing door, and whether the tradesperson has actually done smart locks before — the Airtasker Richmond VIC locksmith listing closes "Looking for someone reliable with previous smart lock experience and a neat finish."

Whether the app and access codes get commissioned as part of the install rather than left to the resident — the same Richmond VIC listing lists "Setting up the app / codes if required" as a separate quotable line item alongside the mechanical fit.
